name: es-foral-income-tax-basque-credits
description: Calculate the 2026 personal, family, housing, care, pension-related and ordinary spending credits of an ordinary resident of Bizkaia, Álava or Gipuzkoa. Covers descendant, ascendant, age, widowhood and disability credits with territorial amounts, judicial child support, care of under-12s and dependants with professional-caregiver routes, return-to-work deemed-return evidence, main-home rent and purchase credits with income gates, carries and the voluntary-filer rent payment, the Álava certified dependency adaptation credit and the home-energy credit with its claim year and community-of-owners allocation. Use for deducciones familiares, deducción por alquiler de vivienda habitual, deducción por adquisición de vivienda, cuidado de menores, dependencia and eficiencia energética in the Basque territories. Load es-foral-income-tax first for residence, bases and the quota. Split unchanged from es-foral-income-tax on 6 November 2026.
